notes:
## Design Material and Shape
- The remote control will use a spongy, stress-ball type rubber material with a firm sub-structure and flexible outer skin.
- The design features a double curved shape with two points of articulation to accommodate left and right-handed users.
- The remote will not include vibrator functionality.
## Color and Branding
- The remote control will be bright yellow to match the logo and make it harder to lose.
- The 'RR' logo will be placed on the top function button.
## Power and Features
- The team agreed to use conventional batteries instead of solar or kinetic power.
- The remote requires on-board memory (flash memory) to store settings so they persist after battery changes.
## Prototyping and Evaluation
- The Industrial Designer and User Interface Designer will work closely on prototyping using clay.
- Product evaluation will involve testing with users, potentially by putting products in the field or street testing.
tldr: The team finalized the conceptual design for a stylish remote control, deciding on a spongy rubber material, a double-curved shape with articulation, and a bright yellow color. They settled on conventional batteries and agreed to drop vibrator functionality. The project will focus on prototyping with clay and evaluating the product with a target audience of younger singles.
